newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Nov 22.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Travel agencies view this year's tourist season with mixed feelings. Since the number of foreigners coming to the Czech Republic and the number of Czechs travelling out of the country increased, the season can be viewed as a success. But the tourist trade also saw a decrease in the rate of growth.

- The contract for the gradual sales of 16 percent of Nova hut and Vitkovice to the companies' management was signed yesterday by the National Property Fund's chairman, Roman Ceska, and the directors of the two steel plants.

- The first round of the sales of Ceska Pojistovna's release of new shares finished yesterday. The new shares are to increase the company's basic capital from 2.27 billion crowns to 3.41 billion crowns. 85 percent of the shares offered were taken.

- Next year, after Unipetrol a.s. finalises their final structure, they will control approximately one third of the fuel market in the Czech Republic. Unipetrol will control 400 filling stations either through Kaucuk a.s. and Chemopetrol a.s., as in the case of K-Petrol a.s. and Torol a.s., or directly, as in the case of Benzina a.s..
MLADA FRONTA DNES - The Ministry of Finance is not intending to make changes to the current value-added taxation system or the consumer taxation system, according to Jan Klak from the ministry.
